sql.position.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.position, p.org_type_id, ot.org_type, p.archived from flow.position p inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = p.org_type_id where ot.company_id = :companyId order by p.position
sql.position.getOne: select p.id, p.position, p.org_type_id, ot.org_type, p.archived from flow.position p inner join flow.org_type ot on ot.id = p.org_type_id where p.id = :id
sql.position.insert: insert into flow.position(company_id, position, org_type_id, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :position, :orgTypeId, :createdById )
sql.position.update: update flow.position set position = :position, org_type_id = :orgTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.position.delete: update flow.position set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
